partners.mechanism_chain: TBCE (HGNC:11538) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); TBCE (HGNC:11538) —LEADS_TO→ Dysmorphism (HP:0001943); TUBA4A (HGNC:23973) —DISRUPTS→ Cytoskeleton organization (GO:0007010); Cytoskeleton organization (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Congenital myopathy (HP:0003198); Cytoskeleton organization (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Intellectual disability (HP:0001249); Cytoskeleton organization (GO:0007010) —LEADS_TO→ Dysmorphism (HP:0001943); TBCE (HGNC:11538) —LEADS_TO→ Hypoparathyroidism (HP:0003145). Loss-of-function mutations in TBCE cause hypoparathyroidism-retardation-dysmorphism syndrome. Loss-of-function mutations in TUBA4A cause congenital myopathy 26. Both TBCE and TUBA4A play roles in neuronal development and function, and TUBA4A is a key component of the cytoskeleton. Dysregulation of cytoskeleton organization by TUBA4A mutations can lead to developmental defects and myopathy. TBCE's role in calcium homeostasis and potentially neuronal development may also contribute to the observed phenotypes, with a shared convergence on impaired neuronal development and cytoskeletal integrity.
